leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the expected structure of URL parameters
Implement a function that parses URL query strings into typed objects
Apply type guards to validate parameter values during parsing
Configure the parser to handle optional and required parameters differently
Integrate the typed parser into a simulated URL handling scenario
Manipulate URL parameter objects using type-safe operations
Initialize and test the parser with various URL query string examples
